{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check assay_batch unit error
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')
print(f'Batch-B mean biomarker_final: {df[df["assay_batch"] == "B"]["biomarker_final"].mean()}')
print(f'Batch-A mean biomarker_final: {df[df["assay_batch"] == "A"]["biomarker_final"].mean()}')"}
